entries.author_note: variant: 轻松 and 放松 share the gloss 'relaxed'; 轻松 means light/easy, not the unwound state needed.
entries.reviewer_reason: 轻松/放松 near-synonyms; 轻松 slightly off for emotional relaxation
entries.author_position: Author: 轻松/放松 share gloss 'relaxed'; 轻松 is light/easy, not the unwound state -> wrong_sense.
entries.reviewer_position: Reviewer: wrong_sense = the learner's word HAS a sense that fits the general form but a different sense of the SAME word was needed (polysemy, e.g. 最初, 仕事). A different lexeme that merely shares an L1 gloss is a near-synonym = wrong_word; the v6 definition says 'real word with the right general form, used in a different dictionary sense'. 轻松 is itself used correctly in a 'relaxed' sense here.

entries.learner_form: 也让我联想到一点关于快乐和友谊的东西
entries.corrected_form: 也让我联想到很多关于快乐和友谊的东西
entries.author_note: 一点 (a little) for 很多 (a lot): quantity weakened, not reversed — the claim that the pattern evokes happiness/friendship still holds. Analogous to many->some, so NOT meaning_inversion. | variant: 一点 is a different quantity word from 很多, not a sense confusion.
entries.reviewer_reason: 很多->一点 is a large->small degree reversal (like many->few), not many->some; borderline
entries.resolution: Reviewer concedes: 一点 'a little' is positive-existential like 'some' (cf. 很少 'little' in zh_silver_10); the claim still holds, so this is many->some, not an inversion. Final word_choice/major/wrong_word.

entries.reviewer_reason: 运送出 (out of) vs 运送到 (to) reverses direction; surface form is complement but label by effect

entries.reviewer_reason: 捐献者 vs 受者 swaps donor/recipient role

entries.reviewer_reason: vague 看情况 drops the three criteria; content lost, nothing reversed, so major not critical
entries.author_position: Author: omission, severity critical kept from source.
entries.reviewer_position: Reviewer: nothing is reversed; critical (weight 25) should be reserved for inversion-grade effects. Content loss of three criteria = MQM major.

entries.author_note: variant: 把…变好 swaps in a different verb frame for 觉得; not a sense confusion of one lexeme.

entries.reviewer_reason: 持つ vs 掴む: hold vs grasp, near-synonym
entries.author_position: Author: 持つ/掴む share gloss 'hold'; 持つ is hold/carry -> wrong_sense.
entries.reviewer_position: Reviewer: wrong_sense = the learner's word HAS a sense that fits the general form but a different sense of the SAME word was needed (polysemy, e.g. 最初, 仕事). A different lexeme that merely shares an L1 gloss is a near-synonym = wrong_word; the v6 definition says 'real word with the right general form, used in a different dictionary sense'. 持つ is used in its normal hold sense; the needed meaning belongs to a different verb.

entries.author_note: 手が動かす for 手を動かす could be read as agent/patient swap, but the result is ill-formed (transitive 動かす with no object) rather than a coherent reversed proposition; the 'moving your hands' claim survives. Kept case_particle.

entries.author_note: reconciled.json: keep wa_ga major — 私たちは作るもの is a relative-clause subject, jev rule 2.

entries.author_note: Added negation 掴めないか for 掴めるか flips the polarity of the tested proposition.
entries.reviewer_reason: 〜ないか確認 in a whether-check is truth-conditionally ~equivalent; embedded-question polarity does not flip the core claim, so NOT inversion

entries.reviewer_position: Reviewer: the negation sits inside an embedded whether-check; 'check whether it can(not) grip' is truth-conditionally the same act and 〜ないか確認 is idiomatic Japanese. Core claim not reversed -> addition/minor (arguably not an error).

entries.author_note: たくさん (many) for いくつか (some/several): degree change, not a reversal — the user's many->some example. NOT meaning_inversion. | variant: たくさん for いくつか: different quantity word.
entries.reviewer_reason: たくさん->いくつか is many->some: degree change without reversal (explicitly not inversion)
entries.resolution: Reviewer concedes severity major: a quantity misstatement is a propositional-content change (consistent with conceding zh_silver_09 at major). Final word_choice/major/wrong_word.

entries.author_note: variant: 高い for 格別: different word (and odd collocation with 達成感).

entries.learner_form: しかし、「プログラミング」を学ぶ
entries.corrected_form: そして、「プログラミング」を学ぶ
entries.author_note: しかし (however) for そして (and): wrong logical relation, but the propositions themselves are not reversed; not meaning_inversion. Arguably v6 `contradiction` (wrong connective relation); kept cohesion_connective per CSV pending ADR-031 boundary rule.
entries.reviewer_reason: しかし (contrast) where そして (addition) needed; claims themselves intact
entries.resolution: Reviewer concedes major: しかし asserts a contrast where addition is meant, misleading the logical relation (en v6 even treats wrong-relation connectives as contradiction/major). Final cohesion_connective/major.

entries.author_position: Author: say/tell share L1 gloss (告诉/言う); 'say' lacks the tell-someone sense -> wrong_sense; severity major kept from source.
entries.reviewer_position: Reviewer: a word lacking the needed sense is wrong_word, not wrong_sense (no sense of 'say' fits); meaning fully recoverable, so minor not major.

entries.learner_form: Or you can avoid simple sticks and glue.
entries.corrected_form: Or you can use simple sticks and glue.
entries.author_note: 'avoid' for 'use': antonym, the recommended action is reversed.
entries.reviewer_reason: avoid vs use: antonymic polarity reversal

entries.learner_form: You also need some servo engines.
entries.corrected_form: You also need some servo motors.
entries.author_note: variant: 'engine' and 'motor' share the L1 gloss (马达/发动机/モーター); 'engine' is the combustion sense, not a servo.
entries.reviewer_reason: engine does not denote an electric servo motor; wrong word (L1 transfer), not a sense issue
entries.author_position: Author: engine/motor share L1 gloss (马达/发动机/モーター); 'engine' is the combustion sense -> wrong_sense.
entries.reviewer_position: Reviewer: wrong_sense = the learner's word HAS a sense that fits the general form but a different sense of the SAME word was needed (polysemy, e.g. 最初, 仕事). A different lexeme that merely shares an L1 gloss is a near-synonym = wrong_word; the v6 definition says 'real word with the right general form, used in a different dictionary sense'. 'engine' has no electric-servo sense, so it is a word that doesn't fit.
